title: TimeIncrement billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = TimeIncrement (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 3. A line's hours are a multiple of the billing increment. Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

incrementHours.description: The billing increment in hours, e.g. 0.1 (six minutes). More than 0, at most 1.
